helplines.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline (Press 3 for LGBTQ+ youth)

decriminalization.summary: State laws criminalizing consensual same-sex sexual conduct are unconstitutional and unenforceable under the Due Process Clause of the Fourteenth Amendment.

marriage.summary: Same-sex marriage is guaranteed nationwide by the Supreme Court and federally codified against interstate non-recognition by the Respect for Marriage Act.

sources.label: Respect for Marriage Act, Pub. L. 117-228, 136 Stat. 2305 (2022)

genderRecognition.summary: Federal U.S. Passports permit self-selected M, F, or X markers without medical certification; state-level identity documents vary from administrative self-ID to outright bans.

sources.label: U.S. Department of State — Selecting Your Gender Marker

conversionTherapy.summary: No federal statutory ban exists; conversion practices on minors are banned in 27 states and DC, but remain legal in the remaining states.

sources.label: Executive Order 14075 — Advancing Equality for LGBTQI+ Individuals (87 FR 37189)

asylum.summary: Persecution on account of sexual orientation or gender identity qualifies for asylum as membership in a particular social group under federal immigration law.

sources.label: Matter of Toboso-Alfonso, 20 I&N Dec. 819 (BIA 1990; AG Order No. 1895-94)
